---
title: "Annotated References"
pagetitle: "References"
---

<div class="page-header">
<p>The page reads <code>references.bib</code> directly, so the visible list and the project bibliography stay in sync.</p>
</div>

<div class="panel">
<div class="search-row">
<input id="reference-search" type="search" placeholder="Search title, author, venue, DOI, or keyword">
<select id="reference-filter">
<option value="all">All categories</option>
<option value="foundations">Foundations</option>
<option value="optimization">Optimization and personalization</option>
<option value="privacy">Privacy and security</option>
<option value="healthcare">Healthcare reviews</option>
<option value="cases">Medical case studies</option>
<option value="multimodal">Multimodal and missing modality</option>
<option value="frontier">2026 frontier</option>
<option value="governance">Governance and evaluation</option>
<option value="teaching">Teaching and tools</option>
</select>
</div>
<p id="reference-count" class="copy-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</div>

<div id="reference-list" class="reference-list"></div>

<script>
const search = document.getElementById("reference-search");
const filter = document.getElementById("reference-filter");
const list = document.getElementById("reference-list");
const count = document.getElementById("reference-count");

const categories = {
  foundations: ["mcmahan2017", "kairouz2021", "li2020challenges", "yang2019fml"],
  optimization: ["li2020fedprox", "karimireddy2020scaffold", "reddi2021fedopt", "li2021fedbn", "fallah2020personalized", "tavakoli2024personalized", "wang2024fairness", "zhu2025fedweight", "pirmani2025ms"],
  privacy: ["bonawitz2017secure", "dwork2014dp", "shokri2017membership", "zhu2019deep", "bagdasaryan2020backdoor", "hitaj2017gan", "froelicher2021famhe", "pati2024privacy", "koutsoubis2025uq"],
  healthcare: ["rieke2020future", "kaissis2020secure", "sheller2020medicine", "kaissis2021end", "antunes2022systematic", "xu2021healthcare", "rehman2023radiology", "darzidehkalani2022part1", "teo2024systematic", "li2025pitfalls", "abdulrahman2026survey", "bakas2026deployment"],
  cases: ["pati2022rare", "dayan2021exam", "karargyris2023medperf", "zenk2025fets", "lo2021oct", "yeom2024pathology", "huang2023aki", "zhang2024adaptive", "mullie2024coda"],
  multimodal: ["pan2024mmfl", "che2023mmfl", "huang2024mmfl", "thrasher2025mmfl", "saha2025incongruent", "fhbench2025", "medmmfl2026", "fedmekt2025", "wang2025missingmodality", "yan2025fedpmg", "fedmir2026"],
  frontier: ["li2025fedfoundation", "bian2025peftfedfm", "wang2026foundationhealthcare", "zhu2025fedweight", "fhbench2025", "medmmfl2026", "koutsoubis2025uq", "zenk2025fets"],
  governance: ["eden2025governance", "bujotzek2025radiology", "vis2021networks", "zech2018generalization", "wynants2020covid", "collins2024tripodai", "vasey2022decide"],
  teaching: ["ramage2020analytics", "cambridge2025course", "stanford2020biods220", "cofe2025tutorial", "miccai2022tutorial", "quartoReveal", "quartoPresenting", "quartoAdvanced", "quartoPages", "flowerDocs", "tensorflowFederatedDocs", "nvflareDocs", "openflDocs", "medperfDocs", "mlcommonsMedical"]
};

const categoryLabels = {
  foundations: "Foundations",
  optimization: "Optimization and personalization",
  privacy: "Privacy and security",
  healthcare: "Healthcare reviews",
  cases: "Medical case studies",
  multimodal: "Multimodal and missing modality",
  frontier: "2026 frontier",
  governance: "Governance and evaluation",
  teaching: "Teaching and tools"
};

const annotations = {
  mcmahan2017: "Introduces FedAvg, the cleanest starting point for explaining one training round.",
  kairouz2021: "Broad technical map of open problems, including privacy, optimization, personalization, and systems.",
  li2020challenges: "Concise overview for moving from basic workflow to real-world limitations.",
  pati2022rare: "Primary rare-cancer example used in the lecture; illustrates why multicentre federation can matter.",
  teo2024systematic: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it quantifies the gap between a large FL literature and much smaller real-life clinical use.",
  li2025pitfalls: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it turns implementation pitfalls into concrete planning questions for healthcare FL.",
  bujotzek2025radiology: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it focuses on real radiology deployment hurdles rather than idealized simulations.",
  zenk2025fets: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it shows why distributed external evaluation and worst-site behavior belong in the main result.",
  dayan2021exam: "Primary multimodal COVID-19 example; useful for connecting imaging, vitals, labs, and outcomes.",
  karargyris2023medperf: "Supports the distinction between federated training and federated benchmarking/evaluation.",
  eden2025governance: "Recent governance review used for the organizational and responsibility portions of the course.",
  pati2024privacy: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it explains why keeping raw data local is not the same as solving privacy.",
  koutsoubis2025uq: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it connects privacy, uncertainty, heterogeneity, and postdeployment monitoring in medical imaging.",
  zhu2025fedweight: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it makes target-site covariate shift a design variable rather than a post-hoc excuse.",
  pirmani2025ms: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it shows personalization gains and local-data limits in routine clinical registry data.",
  thrasher2025mmfl: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it maps multimodal FL choices for projects spanning imaging, text, omics, and EHR.",
  saha2025incongruent: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it studies medical vision-language FL when clients do not contribute matching modalities.",
  fhbench2025: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: preprint benchmark for multimodal healthcare FL; useful, but not yet settled evidence.",
  medmmfl2026: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: preprint benchmark expanding multimodal medical FL tasks; label as emerging evidence.",
  li2025fedfoundation: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: it frames foundation-model FL as a biomedical opportunity with unresolved translation risks.",
  bian2025peftfedfm: "Why this matters to clinical researchers: preprint survey of PEFT in FL; useful for feasibility, not clinical validation.",
  zech2018generalization: "Clear medical AI example showing site-level generalization problems without invoking FL.",
  bonawitz2017secure: "Reference point for secure aggregation as one layer of defence, not a complete privacy guarantee.",
  shokri2017membership: "Motivates membership inference risk and the need to specify a threat model.",
  zhu2019deep: "Motivates gradient leakage risk in distributed learning workflows.",
  bagdasaryan2020backdoor: "Shows why malicious or compromised participants matter in federated settings.",
  collins2024tripodai: "Reporting standard anchor for clinical prediction model transparency.",
  vasey2022decide: "Supports early-stage clinical evaluation and decision-support framing.",
  ramage2020analytics: "Useful contrast case: many distributed questions need analytics rather than model training."
};

function field(entry, name) {
  const regex = new RegExp(`${name}\\s*=\\s*[{"]([\\s\\S]*?)[}"],?\\n`, "i");
  const match = entry.raw.match(regex);
  return match ? match[1].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() : "";
}

function parseBibtex(text) {
  const chunks = text.split(/\n(?=@)/).filter((chunk) => chunk.trim().startsWith("@"));
  return chunks.map((raw) => {
    const head = raw.match(/^@\w+\{([^,]+),/);
    const key = head ? head[1] : "unknown";
    const category = Object.keys(categories).find((name) => categories[name].includes(key)) || "foundations";
    const url = field({ raw }, "url");
    const doi = field({ raw }, "doi");
    return {
      key,
      raw: raw.trim(),
      category,
      title: field({ raw }, "title").replace(/[{}]/g, ""),
      author: field({ raw }, "author").replace(/[{}]/g, ""),
      venue: field({ raw }, "journal") || field({ raw }, "booktitle") || field({ raw }, "publisher") || field({ raw }, "howpublished"),
      year: field({ raw }, "year"),
      doi,
      url,
      annotation: annotations[key] || `Why this matters to clinical researchers: included as supporting evidence for ${categoryLabels[category].toLowerCase()}.`
    };
  });
}

let references = [];

function renderReferences() {
  const query = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const selected = filter.value;
  const shown = references.filter((ref) => {
    const text = [ref.key, ref.title, ref.author, ref.venue, ref.year, ref.doi, ref.url, ref.annotation].join(" ").toLowerCase();
    return (selected === "all" || ref.category === selected) && (!query || text.includes(query));
  });
  count.textContent = `${shown.length} of ${references.length} references shown.`;
  list.innerHTML = shown.map((ref) => `
    <article class="reference-card">
      <h3>${ref.title}</h3>
      <p><span class="badge">${categoryLabels[ref.category]}</span> <strong>${ref.year || "n.d."}</strong> ${ref.venue ? `· ${ref.venue}` : ""}</p>
      <p>${ref.author}</p>
      <p><strong>Why this matters to clinical researchers:</strong> ${ref.annotation.replace(/^Why this matters to clinical researchers:\\s*/i, "")}</p>
      <p>${ref.doi ? `DOI: <a href="https://doi.org/${ref.doi}">${ref.doi}</a>` : ref.url ? `<a href="${ref.url}">Source link</a>` : ""}</p>
      <button type="button" class="secondary" data-key="${ref.key}">Copy BibTeX</button>
    </article>
  `).join("");
}

list.addEventListener("click", async (event) => {
  const button = event.target.closest("button[data-key]");
  if (!button) return;
  const ref = references.find((item) => item.key === button.dataset.key);
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(ref.raw);
  button.textContent = "Copied";
  setTimeout(() => (button.textContent = "Copy BibTeX"), 1200);
});

fetch("references.bib")
  .then((response) => response.text())
  .then((text) => {
    references = parseBibtex(text);
    renderReferences();
  })
  .catch(() => {
    list.innerHTML = `<article class="reference-card"><h3>Reference file unavailable</h3><p>Open <code>references.bib</code> in the repository to view the full bibliography.</p></article>`;
  });

search.addEventListener("input", renderReferences);
filter.addEventListener("change", renderReferences);
</script>
